hero.title: PrivateSeed Access
hero.description: Join a private access round for qualified contributors seeking governance participation, early ecosystem access, and priority token utility before public release.

access-criteria.title: Access Criteria – Who Can Join
access-criteria.description: To qualify, applicants must meet the following:
criteria: Contribution Range: $5,000 to $1,000,000 for Ecosystem Access
Background in Blockchain, Technology, Capital, or Strategic Innovation
Willing to sign NDA and complete identity verification
Seats are limited and may not be available under current terms later

form.title: Application Form
form.subtitle: Foundation Full Seat

placeholders.linkedin: LinkedIn / Github / Company Website (Optional but necessary)
placeholders.experience: Experience in Web3, Investing, or Strategic Partnerships
placeholders.value: What unique value can you contribute to the DEEPROOTS Foundation or Ecosystem? (Experience, resources, skills, network, capital, etc.)
placeholders.whyJoin: Why are you personally or professionally interested in joining the DEEPROOTS mission? (Tell us what resonates with you about our vision.)

form.kyc: Are you able to pass KYC & NDA requirements?
form.consent: Do you agree to be contacted under a confidentiality clause?
form.note_line1: Applications are reviewed within 1–2 business days. All submissions are strictly confidential.
form.note_line2: As a PrivateSeed applicant, you may qualify for:

note_points.access: Early access to exclusive products and features
note_points.profit: Participation in long-term ecosystem engagement programs

form.note_line3: This is a unique opportunity to participate in the foundational community layer of DeWorld — prior to public access.

accessPerks.callDescription: Participate in a private 15-minute community call with the Founder, share ideas, discuss ecosystem participation, and explore long-term community collaboration within DeWorld.
accessPerks.note1: Available only to accepted contributors of $10K or more.
accessPerks.note2: Calls are scheduled in Dubai Time (GMT+4).

q1.question: When will the blockchain launch?
q1.answer: Within 90 days including wallet, DEX, and key ecosystem apps.

q2.question: How do I know if I’m accepted?
q2.answer: You’ll receive an official email within 48 hours.

q3.question: Can I increase my allocation later?
q3.answer: Yes, if additional seats are available at that time.

q4.question: What is the vesting period?
q4.answer: All PrivateSeed tokens follow a custom vesting schedule outlined in your agreement.

q5.question: What if I miss the Private Seed?
q5.answer: You will be added to our official waiting list for future opportunities.
